content: DecAtt: It is important to use gradient clipping for this model: for each gradient update, we check the L2 norm of all the gradient values, if it is greater than a threshold $b$ , we scale the gradient by a factor $\alpha = b/L2\_norm$ . Another useful procedure is to assemble batches of sentences with similar length.
